correctness.rationale: For any finite field F_q, m>=2, evaluation of m square-free monomials M_i=product_{j!=i}X_j over full affine F_q^m is injective by testing the point with exactly x_i=0. If coefficient support size is r, contributions from points with one zero coordinate are r(q-1)^(m-1). On the torus change variables y_i=a_i/x_i: additive-character orthogonality gives N_r=[(q-1)^r+(q-1)(-1)^r]/q zero sums. Weight therefore w_r=(q-1)^m-(q-1)^(m-r)N_r+r(q-1)^(m-1), with multiplicity C(m,r)(q-1)^r. The difference w_{r+1}-w_r=(q-1)^(m-1)+(-1)^r(q-1)^(m-r) yields w1=w2 and all claimed q=2 and q>2 collisions. Independent enumeration of all evaluations for (q,m)=(2,2),(2,4),(2,6),(3,2),(3,4),(5,3) matched full histograms, including [81,4,24]_3 W=1+32z^24+32z^36+16z^42. Infinite prime-power scope rests on additive character identity, not enumerated fields.
